title: Streaming PCA: averaging from a geometric perspective
summary: We study principal component analysis (PCA) under memory constraints, a setting that is increasingly important in large-scale data analysis. Our focus is on Oja's algorithm, which is a one-pass, memory-efficient algorithm requiring only $O(p)$ storage in the rank-one case and $O(pk)$ storage for $k$- PCA. The main goal is to develop a procedure based on Oja's algorithm that is optimal without prior knowledge of the eigengap, which is otherwise needed to tune the learning rates effectively.
